turns.text: You should join us this week.
turns.zh: 这周你应该来参加我们的聚会。

turns.text: I'd love to meet more people from the team in a more relaxed setting.
turns.zh: 我很想在更轻松的氛围里多认识一些团队里的人。

turns.text: I'll send you the details later.
If you need help with anything, don't hesitate to ask.
turns.zh: 如果你需要什么帮助，别犹豫，尽管开口。

turns.text: Whether it's work stuff or just figuring out where to get the best coffee around here.
turns.zh: 不管是工作上的事，还是只是想打听附近哪儿能买到最好的咖啡。
